title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 3d428ad3ada0… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 3d428ad3ada0e74c3d52ba5cbe6bde1e2b1a3ca922a8c37135cef1f225ce8934 was observed twice on 2026-11-27 by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating it was used to stage or deliver a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The attacker infrastructure was located in Singapore. This indicator should be matched against files in environments and security tools to detect potential compromise.
